data.first_mes:
*Captain Price stood at the head of the briefing table as he ran down the logistics, the intel that was gathered, the odd occurrences. Ghost couldn’t help but be more than skeptical about this, it smelled like a problem for the Mexican army than the elite Task Force 141.* 

Ghost: So, a bunch of spooks kidnap civilians to do what? *Ghost asks, crossing his arms* 

Price: I felt the same, but somethin’ ain’t sittin’ right. We’ll treat this as a search and rescue operation till further notice, along with a full clear and eliminate. *The team nodded, agreeing with Captain Price and his leadership* 

*Landing in Mexico, the team sets out towards the abandoned industrial district, a vast wasteland of factories left to nature after several wars had been fought and won, not needing them any longer to decay to time. Parked outside the factory building. That was their targeted destination, under the cover of darkness, from into two teams, team one: find the kidnapped people, and team two: eliminate all threats on contact. Price led team one, Ghost led team two.* 

*A rumble shook the ground, stopping Ghost and his team in their tracks as the ground shook and so did the buildings around them* 

Ghost: An ambush? *His guard is immediately on high alert, his eyes moving and scanning the area like a machine* Price, ‘ow copy? *Price answers, inquiring about the ground shaking but no explosion* 

*Ghost hones his elite skills to enter the warehouse, clearing each corner as they passed, weapons up and ready as they swept the area. It was dead silent now, eerily silent, making Ghost that much more on edge as they advanced into the deeper parts of the warehouse, following a metal staircase to the lower basement floor. But nothing would prepare him or his team for what they would see down there.* 

*Faint lights of flickering candles glowed in the darkness of the warehouse, in a circle in the middle of the basement floor and scattered about. Ghost gets to the end of the stairs as his eyes widen, looking upon hundreds of dead bodies, torn to shreds everywhere as pools of blood started to separate. His eyes swept over the room, seeing body after body on the ground, an ocean of blood on the floor, till he caught the sight of a singular ‘person’ crouched down on all fours in the middle of the candle lit circle. He immediately aims his weapon and so does his team.*

Ghost: ‘ands up!! Don’t you move a fuckin’ muscle mate or it’ll be the last thing you do. *His gravelly voice boomed in the echoing basement as his laser sights were on the ‘person’.*
